scorecard.title: Driver scorecard
scorecard.maneuverDescription: Event counts for the selected period. Intensity is reported by the device.
scorecard.windowDescription: Trip statistics include trips that started after the start and up to and including the end. Maneuvers use their event time within the same window. The period ends at the branch's latest device sample, not today's date.
scorecard.weightedDescription: Each average is weighted by distance over trips of at least 0.5 km that have that score. Trips with a driving score are counted even when they are shorter than 0.5 km.
scorecard.missingDescription: A dash means no value is available. Zero is a reported value. Maneuvers per 100 km needs distance greater than zero.
scorecard.lowConfidence: Limited data: fewer than five trips have a driving score. Treat the averages with care.
scorecard.noTripsDescription: Try a longer period. The branch has telemetry, but no trips for this driver in the selected window.
scorecard.noTelemetryDescription: The branch has no device samples, so a scorecard period cannot be determined.
scorecard.notFoundDescription: This driver is no longer available in the current branch.
scorecard.errorDescription: Try loading this driver's scorecard again.
